items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: You know what Willie Parker called Sheik? What? Gray-Eye George.

ctx.x: You know what Willie Parker called Sheik? What? Gray-Eye George. Yeah. You know?

Yeah. My daddy wasn't that type of guy. He wouldn't call him the gray-eyed guy, but I mean, he would mostly call him Sheik, or, you know, kid him in some other way, but he just, you know... I think my guy, my old man was a guy for a more broad-minded type of guy. Yeah. He was just on a serious base, you know, just like I am, you know, a serious type of guy, you know. He would say what he'd feel, but, you know, he wouldn't drag it to no extent. Uh-huh.
